channel.title: KEYCODE Studio News
channel.description: Latest updates, releases, and announcements from KEYCODE Studio

item.title: KEYCODE Studio v3.0 — Award-Winning Redesign
item.description: Complete visual overhaul with 3D scroll-triggered animations, interactive particle backgrounds, and a unified design system across all pages.

item.title: AI Builder Now Supports Multi-Agent Workflows
item.description: Our AI website builder now orchestrates multiple AI agents in parallel for faster, higher quality generation.

item.title: New PCB Designer with Real-time Simulation
item.description: Design and simulate circuits in real-time with our updated PCB tool. Auto-routing and KiCad export included.

item.title: CAD & 3D Modeling Adds OpenSCAD Support
item.description: Generate parametric 3D models using OpenSCAD syntax directly in the browser. Export to STL, STEP, and 3MF.

item.title: Game Development Platform Launches
item.description: Create AI-powered HTML5 games with Phaser.js. Generate platformers, shooters, and puzzles from text prompts.

item.title: KEYCODE Studio Reaches 500 Projects Delivered
item.description: Milestone achievement: over 500 projects delivered to clients worldwide. Thank you for your trust.

item.title: New Pricing Plans & Free Tier Expansion
item.description: Updated pricing with more generous free tier. All users now get 10 AI generations per day at no cost.

item.title: Security Upgrade: WebAuthn & MFA
item.description: Added passkey support, hardware security key authentication, and adaptive multi-factor authentication.

item.title: Mobile App Beta — Early Access
item.description: Try the KEYCODE Studio mobile app for iOS and Android. Manage projects, chat with AI, and track orders on the go.

item.title: Stripe & Razorpay Payment Integration
item.description: Global payments via Stripe and India-specific payments via Razorpay are now live with automated invoicing.

item.title: AI Health Dashboard Goes Live
item.description: Monitor AI provider status, latency, and availability in real-time. Built-in fallback routing for reliability.

item.title: Open Source Contribution Program Announced
item.description: We are open-sourcing parts of the platform. Community contributions welcome via GitHub.
